# KIVORA

> KIVORA is an AI Knowledge Into Creation platform. It helps users transform their own sources and ideas into books, eBooks, manuals, research drafts, presentations, educational content, visual publications, manga/comics and publish-ready files.

## Canonical public pages
- Home: https://paperpetal-ai.lovable.app/
- Features: https://paperpetal-ai.lovable.app/features
- What you can create: https://paperpetal-ai.lovable.app/create-with-kivora
- Templates: https://paperpetal-ai.lovable.app/templates
- Showcase: https://paperpetal-ai.lovable.app/showcase
- Pricing: https://paperpetal-ai.lovable.app/pricing

## Core capabilities
- Knowledge Engine: organize user-provided YouTube links, PDFs, websites, documents and notes into project knowledge.
- Ask KIVORA: answer questions using project context and sources.
- Writing & Publishing: build structured books, eBooks, manuals and reports.
- Research Workspace: structure academic work, literature review and citations without fabricating evidence.
- Presentation Studio: turn project knowledge into presentation plans and editable slide output.
- Visual Director: create or organize covers, diagrams, infographics and illustrations according to project type.
- Export: PDF, DOCX, EPUB and PPTX according to plan entitlements.

## Important accuracy notes
- Public showcase projects are demos/samples, not customer projects.
- Research and medical/legal content should be verified against appropriate sources before real-world use.
- KIVORA must not fabricate citations, research data, legal authorities, or medical evidence.

## Language
Primary public language: Thai (th-TH). English terminology is used where it is standard or helpful.
